description: This file contains utility functions and constants for parsing command line arguments, specifically options and filters related to test execution configurations.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses an array of command line arguments into file filters and option arguments, recognizing which options require accompanying values.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of explicit file filters provided in the command line arguments.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Extracts the list of file filters specified in the command line arguments.
